name: Fiberon PETG-rCF08 @Qidi X-Plus 4 0.8 nozzle
filament_notes:
Fiberon manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 65 C for 3 h.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed 11.5 mm3/s matches the manufacturer's rating for this printer.
Hardened nozzle required; all-metal hotend recommended but not required. Fan 0-50% (wiki: max 50%, reduce for layer adhesion). Enclosure not needed, keep door open. Store <20% RH. Black; 0.5 kg and 3 kg spools.
Source: https://fiberon.polymaker.com/wp-content/uploads/TDS_FIBERON-PETG-rCF08_V1.0_EN.pdf
